Method of Attack: cryptojacking via malicious Docker container images mining cryptocurrencies (Monero, Grin, Aronium)
Discoverer: Aviv Sasson, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42
Impacted Systems: Docker Hub container environment, various operating systems and CPU architectures supported by Docker containers
Attack Vector: malicious Docker container images uploaded to Docker Hub registry
Indicators of Compromise: wallet addresses and mining pool credentials embedded in container image tags
